title: Warmly Spiced Canadian Corned Beef Hash
description: A hearty and energizing Canadian dish featuring corned beef, perfect for a breakfast or brunch option, with a vegetarian-friendly twist by using vegetarian corned beef alternatives.
instructions: Preheat the air fryer to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, combine the diced vegetarian corned beef, onion, bell pepper, and potato.
In a small bowl, whisk together the mustard, smoked paprika, salt, and black pepper.
Pour the mustard mixture over the corned beef mixture and stir until everything is well combined.
Add the olive oil to the bowl and stir again to coat the mixture evenly.
Transfer the mixture to the air fryer basket and cook for 15 minutes, stirring halfway through.
After 15 minutes, shake the basket to redistribute the ingredients and cook for an additional 5 minutes.
Remove the hash from the air fryer and serve hot.
Garnish with chopped fresh parsley or chives, if desired.
